what_happened: skill-reviser/SKILL.md's Stage 3a (Calculate Artifact Number) already implements the exact max-prefix+1 reconciliation this task wants: after computing artifact_number via the same buggy next_artifact_number // 1 default, it separately scans the whole task directory (find specs/{NNN}_{slug} -name '[0-9][0-9]_*.md', recursive across reports/plans/summaries) for max_on_disk and bumps artifact_number to max_on_disk+1 whenever artifact_number <= max_on_disk. This is directly reusable prior art for fixing skill_read_artifact_number() in skill-base.sh -- porting/extracting this pattern (rather than inventing a new one) would satisfy the max-prefix-not-count requirement and could be shared via a lib helper to de-duplicate the two copies.

Dispatch description names core/scripts/orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh as 'the minting surface' for next_artifact_number, inherited verbatim from the originating PossibleWorlds record. Grep across the whole core extension for next_artifact_number finds zero occurrences in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh; every 'mint' comment in that file refers to dispatch_seq minting, an unrelated counter. The actual next_artifact_number mutation sites in core are orchestrator-postflight.sh, orchestrate-stage5-postflight.sh, orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh (increment on completion), skills/skill-reviser/SKILL.md Stage 8a (increment on revision), commands/task.md Step 6 and context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md Step 4c (creation, both currently omitting the field entirely). Recommend dropping the three declared TERRITORY EDGES on orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh at plan time per the dispatch's own stated escape hatch, since no identified fix touches that file.

Research surfaced skill-reviser/SKILL.md Stage 3a as a working max-prefix reconciliation (find [0-9][0-9]_*.md | sort -n | tail -1, bump when counter <= max); adopted as the reference design for skill_read_artifact_number's normalization instead of inventing one, saving design time at plan time.

Plan-time grep found a SECOND-ORDER defect the research report did not cover: all three next_artifact_number advance sites (orchestrator-postflight.sh:365, orchestrate-stage5-postflight.sh:276, orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh:1610) advance via (.next_artifact_number // 1) + 1, so after the read-side fix mints round 2 for a pre-supplied-01 task, postflight would still store 2 (not 3) and the next plan dispatch would resolve round 1 again. Resolved by designing the read-side normalization as UNCONDITIONAL (max(stored, max_on_disk+1)) rather than only re-arming the dead null branch, which makes the counter self-healing and keeps the three advance sites out of scope.

Confirmed the research recommendation independently: grep of core/scripts/orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh for next_artifact_number returns zero matches, so the dispatch-declared minting surface is stale and the three territory edges against it are dropped; the two adjacent claims the dispatch asked to check (state-write.sh, conclusion-stage.md Step 4c) also stay out of scope because no creation-time write is part of the chosen design.

Phase 1's --only suite run flagged test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh and test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh as NEW failures (run-all's own baseline marks them unexpected). Attributed via git stash push -- scripts/skill-base.sh (isolating only this file) then re-running both suites against the pre-edit file: both failed identically with the edit stashed out, confirming both are pre-existing and unrelated to this change (test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh fails on unrelated skill_validate_task_artifacts global-state assertions; test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh fails on an unrelated project-number-inuse.sh lib resolution error in a temp fixture). test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh also matches the orchestrator's pre-named pre-existing list; test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh was not pre-named but is independently confirmed pre-existing here.
